item.title: Zöi by Mackenzies: From Viral Creators to a Recognized Rwandan Fashion Brand
item.description: Zöi by Mackenzies, also known as Zöi Design Rwanda, is gaining attention for its unique fashion designs, custom-made outfits, and growing international presence. Founded by five Rwandan women, the brand has transformed creativity and social media popularity into a fashion business that celebrates local talent and promotes the Made in Rwanda initiative.
item.dc:creator: Ntagarama Teta Cynthia

item.description: Kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 10 Ugushyingo 2026, nibwo Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Guteza Imbere Ibikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi byoherezwa mu Mahanga (NAEB), cyatangaje ko ikawa y'u Rwanda yegukanye ibihembo bitandatu.

item.title: Lamine Yamal yagize imvune
item.description: Umunya-Espagne ukinira FC Barcelona, Lamine Yamal, ntazagaragara mu mukino ikipe y’igihugu cye izahuramo na Czechia ku wa Kane, tariki ya 12 Ugushyingo 2026, kubera imvune yo mu ivi yagize.

item.title: Kigali’s Live Music Scene Booms with Major Concerts, Chart-Topping Hits, and Industry Milestones
item.description: Rwanda’s music industry is experiencing an exciting wave of live performances, streaming dominance, and heartfelt artist collaborations. From sold-out arena shows to chart-topping gospel anthems, Kigali continues to cement its reputation as a vibrant East African entertainment hub.
item.dc:creator: DERRICK_AUTHOR

item.title: Rwanda Promotes Its Culture Through Diplomacy, Education and Heritage Preservation
item.description: Rwanda is strengthening its cultural identity through international cultural events, education, and heritage preservation. Initiatives such as the Rwanda Diplomatic Charity Bazaar, scheduled for November 21, 2026, promote cultural exchange and community empowerment. The country is also showcasing its traditional music, dance, crafts, and language internationally while encouraging young people to preserve Kinyarwanda and cultural values.
item.dc:creator: Ntagarama Teta Cynthia
